name: Largo Pet Grooming 2
niche: pet grooming (dogs and cats, fixed local shop, no mobile)
hours_note: Tue-Sat 9:00 AM-4:00 PM agrees across reviews.birdeye.com and local.yahoo.com; superpages.com and cmac.ws list slightly later closes (5:00 PM Wed-Sat). Used the majority value (3 independent sources) on-site.
rating_source: reviews.birdeye.com/largo-pet-grooming-2-154465741635815: aggregate 4.6 stars, 237 total reviews, with an explicit per-source breakdown of Google 232, Yellow Pages 5, Birdeye (own) 0. Site and registry use 4.6 / 232 (the Google-attributed slice), same convention as 5star-deluxe-barbershop-fort-lauderdale. Yelp shows an unrelated internal rating (4.0, 33 reviews) that was NOT used, per instructions, since it is Yelp's own separate rating system, not Google's.
facebook_note: Login-walled on fetch (Facebook serves a generic login page to unauthenticated requests), so no usable About/photo data was extracted from it directly. Listed on-site as a real, publicly known channel.
has_own_site_note: largopetgrooming2.com: DNS does not resolve (curl: 'Could not resolve host', confirmed twice). largopetgrooming2.top: DOES resolve (HTTP 200) but is an unrelated Turkish-language content-farm/parked page ('Largopetgrooming2 - Guncel Rehber', generic blog template, zero grooming content) that squats the business name, not the business's real site. Both checked live during this research pass. has_own_site stays false, documented the same way modernnails.com was handled for cocoa-cowrie-beauty-largo.
email_note: Exhaustive search across reviews.birdeye.com, yelp.com (blocked by Cloudflare/DataDome challenge on direct fetch), superpages.com, yellowpages.com, dogdog.org, buzzfile.com, manta.com (403), local.yahoo.com, care.com, nextdoor.com, cmac.ws (429 rate-limited) and facebook.com/largopetgrooming (login-walled) found no public email address anywhere. No email present in any directory listing or on any accessible page.
services_offered: Baths (including medicated baths for sensitive skin)
Specializes in Poodles and Bichons; grooms all breeds and sizes (reviews mention pit bull/terrier mixes, a rottweiler, a yorkie-poo, a westie, a dachshund and a three-legged cat)
services_sources: dogdog.org/pet-groomer/largo-pet-grooming-2-largo (bathing, haircuts, ear cleaning, nail trimming, paw treatments, teeth cleaning)
nextdoor.com/pages/largo-pet-grooming-largo-fl (baths, nail trimming, scissoring, dental care, personalized grooming plans, specializes in Bichons and Poodles)
cmac.ws/superpages.com listing ('Patience, Care and Compassion', certified groomers)
pricing: No current, verifiable published price list found anywhere. One review (ienjoypocky, dated ~13 years old on Birdeye) mentions a historical $25 medicated bath + nail trim for a 110lb dog, but this is far too old to present as a current price, so it was NOT used on-site. Site uses the adapted no-price variant (FORGE-BRIEF 0.b): CTA to call (727) 581-7725 for a phone quote.

reviews.author: Robert K.
reviews.body: I drive a distance just to come here, my dog has little man syndrome since he is a dauschound. Since I have been coming here the staff is always great with buddy and wouldn't bring him anywhere else. Try them out they are right off Starkey rd just south of ulmerton rd. Thanks again guys you have my business as long as I own a pet

reviews.author: Joe H.
reviews.body: 5 STARS ACROSS THE BOARD ! They are wonderful , kind , friendly , and do a great job for an inexpensive price. They accommodate you in all aspects. Thank you , Largo pet grooming 2 Truly the best !

reviews.author: Kelly C.
reviews.body: Love this place everybody there is so friendly and they do a great job on animals I have a cat that has three legs and she gets matted a lot they always seem to get every one of them out such a relief to know that there's a groomer out there that treats animals like humans I wouldn't take my pets anywhere else

reviews.author: William M.
reviews.body: great service, very nice professional employees. affordable grooming service in largo. treated like a person and not a number. loved my visit there ill for sure come back.

reviews_note: Birdeye's own review breakdown attributes 232 of the 237 total reviews to Google, but the individual review TEXT visible on the Birdeye page for this business happens to be tagged by Birdeye as sourced from Yellow Pages (Google review text was not exposed in the fetched page, only its count). Site copy avoids over-claiming platform per quote: uses neutral 'real customer' captions, while the aggregate rating badge honestly cites 4.6/232 on Google via Birdeye.
years_in_business_note: No reliable single founding date: one AI search-summary claimed 1991 (unverifiable, no source page), Buzzfile estimates founded ~2012. The oldest verifiable review on Birdeye is dated '13 years ago' (ienjoypocky), which supports at least ~13 years of operation. Site conservatively says '+10 years' based on that oldest-review evidence, no exact founding year is claimed.
photos_source: 10 photos recovered from local.yahoo.com's og:image tags (Yahoo Local mirrors Google Business Profile photos for this listing) plus 1 photo from Yelp's CDN (s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com) discovered via dogdog.org's embedded img tag. All 11 verified with `file`/PIL as valid JPEGs, sized 41KB-271KB (well above the 15KB minimum), before resizing to max 1000px wide for the build. 9 used on-site (hero, 2 about, 6 gallery), 2 kept as spares in assets/raw but unused.
photos_curation_note: Manually reviewed via a contact sheet before selection. All show finished, calm, camera-ready pets (poodles, a doodle, pit bull/terrier mixes) at the shop or on a grooming chair, several with seasonal photo-prop backdrops (Halloween, Easter) common for grooming salons. None show mid-groom stress, restraint, or text/caption overlays; no staff selfies used as gallery tiles.
notes: Business confirmed NOT present in data/processed.json prior to this build (checked via grep). Slug largo-pet-grooming-2 confirmed unused in output/ and processed.json.
